Oklahoma Public-Entity Website Report Card

The official website of every Oklahoma school district, county, city and town, put through the same eight automated checks on 17 October 2026 to 18 October 2026: HTTPS, phone layout, accessibility, how recently it was updated, broken links, contact details, speed, and the notices a public body is expected to link to. Any check that could not run is marked “couldn’t check” and left out of that site’s score. How the grades work.
